items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Setup output carries suggest_version_bump result; SKILL Step 3 uses it verbatim; AC04-bound tests; ledger row 4 repointed. Nothing else in the skill touched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: No commits -> suggested_version/version_reason are null; first release handled by suggest_version_bump (0.1.0).

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new inputs, no shell-out beyond existing git calls.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Tests run the real setup script in a temp git repo (0.x break -> 0.(x+1).0, >=1.0 break -> major) plus a Step 3 wiring pin.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: One extra in-memory parse of already-fetched commits.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Follows existing setup-changelog.py and test file conventions; files well under 300 LOC.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Setup JSON gains two fields consumed only by the skill prose; additive, no serialized-format round trip.
